row.name: Alvin Learning Tree Academy and Daycare

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: Caregiver had an expired transportation training certificate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children: Operation did not account for all children when loading and unloading children off the van. This caused a child to be left on the van for approximately 30 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children (26 TAC §746.5605(3))

occurrences.finding: Franchise Tax Delinquent: As of today, 7-07-2026 the secretary filing number is showing inactive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 Survey data from January 17, 2025, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area: The infant room did not have a sink next to the diaper changing table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area (26 TAC §746.4403(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: Two vans  did not have a working vehicle safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: The diaper changing table was observed to be not clean. The diaper changing table was observed with white and brown dirt stains on the surface.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: The infant room had 2 caregivers caring for 12 infants. This classrrom was out of ratio based on the specified age group of 0-11 months. The classroom was over ratio by 2 infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: After reviewing staff files there were six employees who has taken CPR/First Aid online
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: I observed a caregiver not wash her hand nor the child's hand before or after diaper changing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands: I observed a caregiver not wash her hand nor the child's hand before or after diaper changing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: There is no documentation that the monthly check were done for the months of September, October, November or December.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Current Driver's License: A caregiver who transport child  in care did not have a valid driver license.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: There is no documentation that the monthly check were done for the months of September, October, November or December.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: There was no drills documentation for the months of November and December.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: There is no documentation that the monthly check were done for the months of September, October, November or December.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Caregiver with hire date 05/05/2022 whom  transport children do not have the required transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on the preponderance of information obtained during the investigation there is sufficient evidence to support a citation for prohibited punishment by a caregiver pushing a child down.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: An infant was observed being left unsupervised in a classroom. The caregiver was unaware that the infant was under her care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on information obtained during the DFPS investigation, a child was spanked with a ruler as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information obtained during the DFPS investigation, a child left a classroom without caregivers knowledge.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation: Based on information obtained during the DFPS investigation, children have been placed in time out longer than allowed for their age. A 3-year-old child was in time out for approximately 5-10 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(D))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The operation purchased a new van that still have paper plates. The van was used to transport children prior to having the electronic safety alarm installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a citation that a classroom was not free from choking objects.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The individual cots were not  labeled to distinguish individual use.  This deficiency was corrected during the visit when each cot was labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two infant feeding sheets were not updated within the 30-day requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - May Supplement Activities Not Replace: There are 6 infants in care from ages 12 months to 23 months old. The television was on and playing sing-along videos. This was corrected at inspection when the director turned the television off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - May Supplement Activities Not Replace (26 TAC §746.2207(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The annual report has not been done for this year. The last report was 09/02/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment: I reviewed 4 files and none of the files had the hire date in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment (26 TAC §746.901(1))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: I observed several bottles of bleach, Arm and Hammer, Lysol sanitizer on the wash machine in the restroom that was accessible to children. This was corrected when the director removed the chemicals.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: I  observed that the monthly check had not been  conducted nor documented for the month.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: I observed a van without the safety alarm installed on it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: I observed that the monthly check had not been  conducted nor documented for the month.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: I reviewed 4 files and 2 files did not have the notarized Licensing Affidavit for Applicants for Employment form completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
